content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Flagged AUDIT as a deviation and proposed a three-part fallback-level redline.

- **Section 7.4 (p0481–p0482)** — the royalty records inspection right — already delivers most of the preferred position (once each Calendar Year, independent CPA firm reasonably acceptable to Ono, confidentiality undertaking, Array bears cost), but the notice is only "reasonable prior written notice" and the cost-shift trigger is redacted. Fixed at 15 days' notice and a 10% underpayment threshold.
- **Section 4.9(a) (p0359)** — a separate, unlimited facility inspection right binding Ono with no frequency cap and only "reasonable advance notice" — walk-away territory. Capped at once per year on at least 15 days' written notice; existing business-hours language preserved verbatim.
- Left untouched the elements already in Ono's favour (business hours, independent auditor, auditor confidentiality) rather than upgrading to preferred wording.
